glutes.label: GLUTES
glutes.note: Volume is rarely the real limiter. The usual pattern is a tucked pelvis under load, where the glutes never fully shorten — so extra sets just add fatigue. Test it first: a hip thrust should be felt in the glutes, not the lower back or the hamstrings.

hamstrings.label: HAMSTRINGS
hamstrings.note: You cannot reduce fat over a muscle by training that muscle. Spot reduction does not work — leanness comes from the deficit, and this only builds what sits underneath it.

arms.label: ARMS
arms.note: Biceps already work on every row and pulldown in the plan. The usual gap is total pulling volume, not curls — check how much back work is actually in the week before adding more direct arm work.

shoulders.label: SHOULDERS
shoulders.note: Front delts are already covered by every press you do. Side delts are what is missing, and they respond to frequency and lighter high-rep work far more than to heavy pressing.

core.label: CORE
core.note: Abs are visible at low body fat and are trained like any other muscle — crunches do not burn belly fat. A longer plank mostly builds tolerance for being bored, so this adds sets, not minutes, and they stay at the front of the session.

back.label: BACK
back.note: Vertical pulling and horizontal rowing are not interchangeable and most people are short on one of them. Check the split before adding volume — three rows and no pulldown is a gap, not a preference.

chest.label: CHEST
chest.note: Flat versus incline matters less than most people think. What usually limits chest growth is load in the stretched position at the bottom — pressing through a short, comfortable range skips exactly the part that drives it.

spine.label: RIB / SPINE
spine.why: Neither a leg curl nor a hip thrust loads the spine the way a bar on your back or a loaded hinge does.

lowback.label: LOWER BACK
lowback.why: Supported and machine-based work keeps the hamstrings and glutes loaded without asking the lower back to brace a free weight.

shoulder.label: SHOULDER
shoulder.why: Chest-supported rowing and light band work keep the upper back moving without overhead or bench loading.

knee.label: KNEE
knee.why: Hip-dominant work loads the glutes and hamstrings without bending the knee under load.

elbow.label: ELBOW / WRIST
elbow.why: Machine pressing and fly work keeps chest and shoulder volume up while the elbow settles.

cue.bench: Shoulder blades pinned, feet planted. Lower to mid-chest, press up and slightly back.
cue.incline: Bench at 30°. Elbows about 45° from your body, lower until the dumbbells reach your chest line.
cue.ohp: Ribs down, glutes tight. Press straight up and finish with biceps by your ears.
cue.side_delt: Lead with the elbows, stop at shoulder height. Light weight, no swinging.
cue.pulldown: Chest up, pull the bar to your upper chest, elbows down and back.
cue.pullup: Start from a dead hang, pull your chest toward the bar, lower under control.
cue.row: Flat back, pull the elbow toward your hip and squeeze the shoulder blade back.
cue.tri: Elbows pinned to your sides, only the forearms move. Full lockout.
cue.curl: Elbows still, no swinging. Lower slowly, about 3 seconds down.
cue.squat: Weight on mid-foot, chest up, knees track over toes. Hips just below the knees.
cue.legpress: Feet shoulder-width, lower until knees reach about 90°. Never lock the knees hard.
cue.hinge: Hips back, soft knees, bar close. Stop when your back wants to round.
cue.hipthrust: Chin tucked, ribs down. Drive through the heels and squeeze the glutes at the top.
cue.hamcurl: Hips stay down on the pad. Curl fast, lower slowly.
cue.single_leg: Front foot does the work. Torso tall, push through the whole foot.
cue.abduction: Sit tall, push the knees out against the pads, pause one second at the widest point.
cue.sl_hinge: Hinge on one leg, the free leg reaches back. Hips square. Touch something if you wobble.
cue.carry: Stand tall, shoulders down, short quick steps. Breathe and keep walking.
cue.core_flex: Curl the pelvis up, not just the legs. No swinging.
cue.core_antiext: Lower back pressed into the floor the whole time.
cue.core_antirot: Arms straight out, resist the cable pulling you sideways. Hips square.
cue.core_antilat: Straight line from head to feet, hips high.
cue.glute_iso: Squeeze the glutes, not the lower back.
cue.fly: Slight bend in the elbows, open wide, squeeze together.
cue.rear_delt: Pull toward your face, elbows high, squeeze between the shoulder blades.
cue.legext: Pause one second at the top.
cue.calf: Full stretch at the bottom, pause at the top.
